title: Lieges of Legendre
statementMd:
Kevin and Nicky Sun have invented a new game called Lieges of Legendre. In this game, two players take turns modifying the game state with Kevin moving first. Initially, the game is set up so that there are $*n*$ piles of cows, with the $*i*$-th pile containing $*a*_{*i*}$ cows. During each player's turn, that player calls upon the power of Sunlight, and uses it to either:

1. Remove a single cow from a chosen non-empty pile.
2. Choose a pile of cows with even size $2·*x*$ ($*x* > 0$), and replace it with $*k*$ piles of $*x*$ cows each.

The player who removes the last cow wins. Given $*n*$, $*k*$, and a sequence $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$, help Kevin and Nicky find the winner, given that both sides play in optimal way.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two space-separated integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000, 1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{9}$).

The second line contains $*n*$ integers, $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ... *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) describing the initial state of the game.

## Output

Output the name of the winning player, either "`Kevin`" or "`Nicky`" (without quotes).

## Note

In the second sample, Nicky can win in the following way: Kevin moves first and is forced to remove a cow, so the pile contains two cows after his move. Next, Nicky replaces this pile of size 2 with two piles of size 1. So the game state is now two piles of size 1. Kevin then removes one of the remaining cows and Nicky wins by removing the other.
statementZhMd:
凯文和尼基·孙发明了一种名为 Lieges of Legendre 的新游戏。在这个游戏中，两名玩家轮流修改游戏状态，由凯文先手。初始时，游戏中有 $*n*$ 堆牛，第 $*i*$ 堆中有 $*a*_{*i*}$ 头牛。每名玩家在自己的回合中都会借助阳光的力量，进行以下操作之一：

1. 从选定的一堆非空牛堆中移除一头牛。
2. 选择一堆大小为 $2·*x*$ 的牛（$*x* > 0$），将其替换为 $*k*$ 堆大小均为 $*x*$ 的牛。

移除最后一头牛的玩家获胜。给定 $*n*$、$*k*$ 以及序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$，请在双方都采取最优策略的情况下，判断凯文和尼基谁会获胜。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个以空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{9}$）。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ... *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示游戏的初始状态。

## 输出格式

输出获胜玩家的名字，应为 "`Kevin`" 或 "`Nicky`"（不含引号）。

## 说明

在第二个样例中，尼基可以采取以下策略获胜：凯文先手，并且被迫移除一头牛，因此操作后这堆中还剩两头牛。接下来，尼基将这堆大小为 2 的牛替换为两堆大小为 1 的牛。此时游戏状态为两堆大小为 1 的牛。凯文随后移除其中一头牛，尼基再移除另一头牛并获胜。
